layers.name: background
layers.rule: May be cropped or extended. Keep the moon in frame.

layers.name: key-art
layers.rule: May be scaled and moved. Never cropped: the whole lighthouse and its lamp stay visible.

layers.name: tagline
layers.rule: May be dropped on sizes under 600px on the short side.

layers.name: title
layers.rule: Never distorted, never cropped. May be scaled. May stack on two lines or run on one.

layers.name: billing
layers.rule: Legal. Must appear on every size above 900px on the short side, at a cap height of at least 15% of the title cap height.

layers.name: studio-logo
layers.rule: Fixed proportions. Clear space of half its height on all sides.

layers.name: rating
layers.rule: Legal. Must appear on every size.
